title: Save Water, Save Life
summary: Where our water comes from and easy ways to use less of it.

steps.title: Water is precious
sentences: Plants, animals and people all need water to live.
Most of Earth's water is salty sea water that we cannot drink.
Only a small part is fresh water that we can use.

steps.title: Where it comes from
sentences: Rain fills rivers, lakes and the ground.
We take water from them, clean it and send it to taps.
In Chennai and many places in India, people have also used tanks, ponds and wells for storing rain.

steps.title: Small steps
sentences: Turn the tap off while brushing your teeth.
Fix a dripping tap, because drops add up to many litres.
Use a bucket instead of a hose for washing, and finish your drink instead of pouring it away.

steps.title: Catch the rain
sentences: Rainwater harvesting means collecting rain from rooftops and letting it soak into the ground or fill a tank.
Tamil Nadu was one of the first states in India to make rainwater harvesting compulsory in buildings, in 2003.
This helps keep wells and groundwater full.

facts: A dripping tap can waste thousands of litres of water in a year.
Many old temple towns in Tamil Nadu have big tanks that fill with rain.
About two thirds of your body weight is water.

options: Wash with a hose for long
Collecting rain to use or store
quiz.why: It means catching rain from roofs and storing it or letting it soak into the ground.

quiz.q: What kind of water can people drink?
quiz.why: We drink fresh water that has been cleaned.
